tagline: I build whole systems, end to end — web, mobile, AI agents and the operations around them — in whatever stack the problem needs.
summary: Full-stack engineer who builds the whole system a problem needs, in whatever stack it needs; this version of my CV leads with Python and AI. My deepest Python work is backend and LLM systems: multi-agent pipelines on FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Redis and Celery, with Prometheus, Grafana and Sentry across containerised services. Around that I own the rest: React and Vue front-ends, data modelling, auth and row-level security, Docker, CI/CD, Playwright tests from day one, and AI agents that do real work behind safety gates written in code. I run an independent studio that delivers for clients in Nigeria and the Netherlands. In tech since 2010.
